text: {"assertions":["A plan drift issue was discovered in the VPC module in infra/terraform/vpc.tf.","The plan drift only manifested for deeply nested inputs beyond six levels of nesting.","The root cause was an unbounded retry loop lacking backoff logic that kept re-running unnecessarily.","The fix capped retry attempts and added exponential backoff with jitter to prevent runaway loops.","The fix was implemented in PR #1293 on branch fix/plan-drift-1.","The issue could be reproduced by running Terraform plan twice consecutively without making any changes.","The performance improvement was dramatic, reducing the job execution time from 3 hours to 15 minutes."]}
